class: A single type-and-read of a password box mistook a still-settling box for a refused one, stopping the run instead of retyping
fix: browser_automation._type_password_box_until_kept types each password box, waits for it to settle, tabs out, and retries from a cleared box up to three times before naming the failure; the value is never logged. The pair-match rule is unchanged.
prevention: Secret fields are verified settled (read back after a beat, tried again cleared) rather than judged from one immediate read.
root_cause: Workday drops keystrokes while its password boxes still render; the login loop typed once, read the value back immediately, and treated the empty unsettled box as a refusal. Two of four Analog Devices runs on 3 November stopped with the email filled and both passwords blank.
site: Account sign-in loop, browser_automation.py, 3 November 2026 (Analog Devices Workday)
symptom: Runs stopped at Create Account/Sign In with the email filled and both password boxes empty, though typing had been attempted.
why_tests_missed: Login-box tests used stable doubles that keep every keystroke, so no test typed into a box that drops or delays input.
